summary: A tracked troop carrier with a fast-firing 30 mm autocannon. It shreds light vehicles, infantry and low drones, carries a squad safely to the front, and swims across rivers.

sections.title: Autocannon
sections.how: Select the BMP-2 and right-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The 2A42 fires quick bursts. It is deadly against infantry, scouts and other light vehicles, and can track low drones, but it struggles against a main battle tank.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select infantry, then left-click the BMP-2.
sections.body: Up to six soldiers ride inside. Riders lose only a tenth of their health if the BMP-2 is destroyed, but they cannot shoot out: it has no firing ports. Riders cannot be selected until they leave.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded BMP-2 and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Swim rivers
sections.how: Select the BMP-2 and right-click the far bank.
sections.body: The BMP-2 is amphibious: it crosses deep water at the same speed as open ground. Tanks and other non-swimming vehicles must use a bridge.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged BMP-2 and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The BMP-2 drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Pair it with tanks: the tank fights armour, the BMP-2 clears the infantry around it.
Unload anti-tank teams behind cover instead of driving the BMP-2 into a tank.
Use rivers as roads: the BMP-2 can flank where enemy tanks cannot follow.
